_about: Guided questions for the voter advisor. Issue ids match the chips in site/issues.js. Options are approaches a candidate can support or oppose; they are not mutually exclusive. Wording must stay neutral: describe the approach, not its merits.

housing.text: What should government do most about housing costs?

options.label: Allow more homes to be built
options.detail: Zoning changes, faster permits, more density

options.label: Fund affordable housing directly
options.detail: Public or nonprofit housing paid for with public money

options.label: Cut costs, taxes and rules on building
options.detail: Lower fees, taxes and regulations rather than new programs

housing.text: What's the right approach to homelessness?

options.label: Housing and shelter first
options.detail: More shelter, supportive and permanent housing

options.label: Mental health and addiction treatment
options.detail: Expand treatment and behavioral health services

safety.text: Which approaches to public safety do you favor?

options.label: Stronger gun laws
options.detail: Permits, limits on certain weapons, safe storage

options.label: Raise revenue from the wealthy and large corporations
options.detail: Capital gains, wealth or payroll taxes on high earners

options.label: No new taxes; cut or hold taxes
options.detail: Oppose tax increases, roll back taxes

options.label: Lower taxes on working families
options.detail: Reduce sales or property tax burden, tax credits

transport.text: What should transportation money go to first?

options.label: Safe streets for walking and biking
Strong climate action
options.detail: Cut emissions, clean energy, keep or expand climate laws

options.label: Keep energy and gas costs down first
options.detail: Oppose or roll back costly climate mandates

schools.text: For schools and kids, what matters most?

options.label: More school funding
options.detail: Fully fund schools, special education, staff

options.label: Parents' rights and say over curriculum
Protect abortion access
options.detail: Keep or expand reproductive health access

options.label: Help small businesses
options.detail: Lower costs and red tape for local business

options.label: Business-friendly climate
options.detail: Fewer regulations and taxes on employers

options.label: Protect immigrant communities
options.detail: Limit cooperation with federal immigration enforcement
